PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION.en: Would you like me to pay this bill for you?
PAYMENT_CONFIRMATION.zh_yue_draft: 要唔要我幫你交呢張單？

DATA_INSUFFICIENT.en: I couldn't read all the bill details. Please retake the photo or type them in.
DATA_INSUFFICIENT.zh_yue_draft: 我睇唔清張單嘅資料。請重新影相，或者自己輸入。

SCAM_SIGNAL.en: This payment was stopped because it matches a safety warning. Do not pay; check with an official channel.
SCAM_SIGNAL.zh_yue_draft: 呢筆付款因為符合安全警示，已經停止。請唔好付款，先用官方渠道查證。

OVER_HARD_CAP.en: This amount is above the payment limit, so it was not sent. Please check with your bank through an official channel.
OVER_HARD_CAP.zh_yue_draft: 呢個金額超出付款上限，所以冇付款。請用官方渠道向銀行查詢。

PAYEE_UNKNOWN.en: We don't recognise this payee. Please check the details or ask your child before deciding.
PAYEE_UNKNOWN.zh_yue_draft: 我哋未能確認呢個收款人。請先核對資料，或者問屋企人。

OVER_LIMIT.en: This amount is above the usual payment limit for this payee. Please check it before deciding.
OVER_LIMIT.zh_yue_draft: 呢個金額超出呢個收款人平時嘅付款上限。請先核對。

AMOUNT_HIGH.en: This bill is much more than usual. We can't confirm it is genuine; please check first.
AMOUNT_HIGH.zh_yue_draft: 呢張單比平時高好多。我哋未能確認張單真偽，請先查清楚。

NO_HISTORY.en: There aren't enough past bills to compare this amount.
NO_HISTORY.zh_yue_draft: 之前嘅帳單資料唔夠，暫時未能比較呢個金額。

VOICE_UNRECOGNIZED.en: I didn't catch that. Please tap a button.
VOICE_UNRECOGNIZED.zh_yue_draft: 我聽唔清楚，請按一下按鈕。

APPROVAL_EXPIRED.en: This request expired. No money was sent. Please start again if you still want to pay.
APPROVAL_EXPIRED.zh_yue_draft: 呢個付款要求已經過期，冇扣到錢。如果仍然想付款，請重新開始。

BUDGET_GAP.en: Serious budget gap: fixed costs exceed income by RM {gap}. This plan is not balanced. Review or reduce costs before setting a daily spending limit.
BUDGET_GAP.zh_yue_draft: 嚴重預算缺口：固定開支比收入多 RM {gap}。呢個預算未平衡，請先檢查或減少開支。

WEEKLY_REPORT_SUMMARY.en: This week you spent RM {total_spent} across {category_count} spending categories.
WEEKLY_REPORT_SUMMARY.zh_yue_draft: 今個星期你喺 {category_count} 個類別一共用咗 RM {total_spent}。

CATEGORY_SPENDING_HIGH.en: Spending on {category} is RM {over_by} above its weekly budget. Consider lowering nonessential spending or choosing a lower-cost alternative.
CATEGORY_SPENDING_HIGH.zh_yue_draft: {category} 開支超出每週預算 RM {over_by}。可以減少非必要開支，或者選擇較平嘅替代品。

NEXT_WEEK_DAILY_LIMIT.en: After setting aside RM {essential_costs} for essentials, RM {remaining} is available over {days} days: RM {daily_limit} per day.
NEXT_WEEK_DAILY_LIMIT.zh_yue_draft: 預留 RM {essential_costs} 作必要開支後，{days} 日仲有 RM {remaining}：每日 RM {daily_limit}。

NEXT_WEEK_BUDGET_GAP.en: Essential costs exceed the available balance by RM {gap}. No daily spending limit is set until the gap is addressed.
NEXT_WEEK_BUDGET_GAP.zh_yue_draft: 必要開支比可用餘額多 RM {gap}。處理缺口前，暫時唔會設定每日開支上限。

policy: Templates are selected by server-side risk code; never generate payment decisions or free-form risk claims with a language model.
